basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a college senior based in Troy, NY, currently exploring and embracing my identity. I recently started using Reddit to connect with others and find local LGBTQ+ communities. I love nightlife, particularly exploring unique bars and clubs. My interests also include music, especially techno and house, which is why I'm often on the 'berghain' subreddit. I have a part-time job at a local café, providing me with a flexible schedule to enjoy my nights out. I'm single and open to meeting new people. Typically, I'm online during late evenings to early mornings, making the most of my night owl tendencies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to Reddit and the LGBTQ+ community, much of my knowledge comes from personal experience and exploring online resources. I'm learning a lot through trial and error, community interactions, and reading up on topics that interest me.
